title: 第一百二十八章 胜败第一百二十七章 谁是黄雀
content_zh:
第一百二十八章胜败
萧凉淡然一笑，“我知道你们在等我们，可是，我们何尝不是需要你们刻意放松，才能靠近？”
声音落下的那一瞬间，只见苏清绾已然激射而出，宛若流星划过天际，直奔昭华而去。
所有人都不会想到，从一开始，萧凉的出现，只不过是为了吸引人所有人的注意力。
真正的杀招是苏清绾，她拥有天命境中期的修为，而且还拥有越境界战斗的能力。
从任何角度来看，萧凉的布局都是没有问题的。
可是，在这时候最为令人意想不到的一幕出现了。
昭华身子微微一顿，右手抬起，一道无以形容的浑厚灵力爆发。
恐怖的道则之力密密麻麻交织在一起，释放出来无以形容的强悍气息。
苏清绾就像是撞在了一堵无形的墙壁之上，恐怖的反震之力陡然袭来，她闷哼一声，一个倒空翻来到萧凉身边。
此时萧凉和苏清绾眼中均是有震惊之色，他们从未想过昭华竟然拥有天命境巅峰的修为。
“你们当朕手无缚鸡之力？”昭华眼中满是讥诮之色。
她本身也是天命境巅峰的高手，只为才是她真正的底牌。
“了不得啊。”萧凉并没有因为局势发生变化而有任何畏惧的举动，他比之前更为淡定。
因为萧凉清楚明白，越是这个时候，越是需要淡定从容。
“呵呵，告诉你们，今日这里，就是你们的葬身之所。”昭华退到后面，屠方和赵贤上前，此时他们看着萧凉和苏清绾，眼中尽是得意之色。
“六先生，这一次不知道你打算如何离开呢？”赵贤眼中尽是戏谑之色，他抽出长刀猛地劈下。
萧凉双手交叉，灵力汇聚，陡然间呼啸而出。
轰的一声巨响，赵贤被震得连连后退出去，眼中充满了震惊之色。
不久之前，萧凉还是洞幽境初期的修为，今日再次见面，萧凉竟然已经是洞幽境巅峰。

最为恐怖的是，萧凉灵力之浑厚，丝毫不下于任何天命境巅峰的高手。
“当真是个不错的天骄，只是可惜走错了路。”昭华说道。
萧凉道：“当年流川一战，是你勾结荒国，埋伏在回龙谷杀了我父亲？”
“说什么鬼话呢。”昭华淡然一笑，她自然不会承认。
但是，萧凉心中已经有了答案。
“六先生愿意归顺的话，朕可以既往不咎。”昭华看着萧凉的那张脸，越看越是喜欢，比洛行舟还要好看。
萧凉轻笑一声，“你觉得可能吗？”
“既然敬酒不吃吃罚酒，那就只能对不住了。”昭华一挥手，那些围住萧凉的高手顿然出手。
他们早就练成了一套极为厉害的合击阵法，一出手力量汇聚就极为恐怖，不是简单的一加一。
萧凉和苏清绾被围在中间，一时间进退无路。
“以人力布置而成的阵法是最灵活的，但同时也是破绽最多的。”
苏清绾迈步走出，凝聚的力量在指尖，朝着空中一点。
轰隆巨响之声传来，霎时间，整座大阵顿然震荡起来。
萧凉抓住机会，斩妄剑在他的控制之下，化作一道流光朝着阵法的破绽之处攻去。

Chapter 128 Victory or defeat
Xiao Liang smiled calmly, "I know you are waiting for us, but don't we need you to relax deliberately before we can get closer?"
The moment the voice fell, Su Qingwan was seen shooting out, like a meteor streaking across the sky, heading straight for Zhaohua.
No one would have thought that from the beginning, Xiao Liang's appearance was just to attract everyone's attention.
The real killer move is Su Qingwan. She has a cultivation level in the middle stage of Destiny Realm, and she also has the ability to fight across realms.
From any angle, there is no problem with Xiao Liang's layout.
However, at this time the most unexpected scene appeared.
Zhaohua paused slightly, raised his right hand, and an indescribable burst of powerful spiritual power erupted.
The terrifying power of Taoism is densely intertwined, releasing an indescribably powerful aura.
Su Qingwan seemed to have hit an invisible wall, and a terrifying backlash suddenly hit her. She groaned and somersaulted to Xiao Liang's side.
At this time, Xiao Liang and Su Qingwan both had shocked looks in their eyes. They had never thought that Zhaohua actually had a cultivation level at the peak of the Destiny Realm.
"You think I am powerless to restrain a chicken?" Zhaohua's eyes were filled with ridicule.
She is also a master at the pinnacle of the Destiny Realm, and only because is her real trump card.
"It's amazing." Xiao Liang did not show any fear because of the change in the situation. He was calmer than before.
Because Xiao Liang clearly understood that at this time, the more he needed to be calm and calm.
"Haha, let me tell you, today's place is where you will be buried." Zhaohua retreated to the back, while Tu Fang and Zhao Xian stepped forward. At this time, they looked at Xiao Liang and Su Qingwan, their eyes filled with pride.
"Mr. Six, I don't know how you plan to leave this time?" Zhao Xian's eyes were full of teasing, and he drew out his long knife and slashed it down.
Xiao Liang crossed his hands, gathered his spiritual power, and suddenly roared out.
There was a loud bang, and Zhao Xian was so shocked that he stepped back repeatedly, his eyes filled with shock.
Not long ago, Xiao Liang was still at the early stage of Dongyou Realm. When we meet again today, Xiao Liang is already at the peak of Dongyou Realm.
The most terrifying thing is that Xiao Liang's spiritual power is no less powerful than any master at the peak of the Destiny Realm.
"He is really a good genius, but it's a pity that he took the wrong path." Zhaohua said.
Xiao Liang said: "During the battle in Liuchuan, was it you who colluded with Huangguo and ambush me in Huilong Valley to kill my father?"
"What nonsense are you talking about?" Zhaohua smiled lightly. Naturally, she would not admit it.
However, Xiao Liang already had the answer in his heart.
"If Mr. Six is ​​willing to surrender, I can put the blame in the past." Zhaohua looked at Xiao Liang's face, and the more he looked at it, the more he liked it. It was even prettier than Luo Xingzhou.
Xiao Liang chuckled, "Do you think it's possible?"
"Since you don't have to drink wine as a penalty, I can't help but apologize." Zhaohua waved his hand, and the masters surrounding Xiao Liang suddenly took action.
They have long since practiced an extremely powerful combined attack formation. Once the power is gathered together, it is extremely terrifying. It is not a simple one plus one.
Xiao Liang and Su Qingwan were surrounded in the middle and had no way to advance or retreat for a while.
"The formation formed by human power is the most flexible, but it also has the most flaws."
Su Qingwan stepped out, condensing strength at her fingertips, pointing towards the air.
A loud rumbling sound was heard, and in an instant, the entire formation suddenly shook.
Xiao Liang seized the opportunity, and under his control, the Zhanwangjian turned into a stream of light and attacked the flaw in the formation.
